composition.note: New structural training variants chosen after consumed V8 development failures. Exact held texts and held subject strings excluded, but structure/lexical overlap exists; not independent natural language data.

ordinary_replay.selection: Deterministic scenario round robin, seed20261112, fixed cap480, independent of model scores or development labels
ordinary_replay.sampling: Same balanced15-class sampler as V9; only lexical pool changes
ordinary_replay.limits: Authored synthetic source; route labels inherited from original ordinary task design, not human reviewed. Exact held texts excluded. No new reference minimal-pair augmentation in this arm.
